result.notes: The category splits cleanly: three P1s that are the process-separation core plus an actual multiprocess crash fix, a broad P2 tier of platform coverage, stacked separation milestones, and IPC resource/stability options, and a P3 tail of tests, build checks, and interface polish. Platform PRs (#32387, #36105, #36106) were kept at P2 rather than P1 because multiprocess binaries are still experimental, so these are enabling work rather than regressions on an already supported configuration.
